scope: R2B ordinary cage, empty-slot filler and bottom wall tile-copy loops

initialRecordWrites.policy: Evidence only. Do not relocate legacy saves or infer original initialization is integrated.

ordinary.sourceCrop: upper row skips first 3 source tile rows; lower row skips none
ordinary.destination: base + sourceRowAfterCrop * stride + sourceColumn; subtract stride once when base%stride + sourceColumn >= stride
ordinary.skip: tile == tileBase AND (rawAttribute & 1) != 0 skips all writes
writes: raw attribute and definition owner only if rawAttribute != 1
attribute low bit and owner only when low bit is zero

wall.origin: destination row 19, repeat every 12 columns, unlockedCount/2 repeats
wall.writes: nonzero source raw tile writes u16(tileBase + raw); no attribute, collision or owner change

waitingRoomBoundary: Definition 35 is fixed in editor initialization; definition 36 is the empty-space filler. The copy loops accept explicit inputs. This contract does not establish automatic save migration or full native field-record creation.

runtimeBoundary.sourceProvider: Existing production art and gameplay authorities must supply separately eligible inputs
runtimeBoundary.preserveRawMetadata: No collision class, walkability, effect, spawn or ownership gameplay interpretation
